test.create_query: CREATE TABLE itt (l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_quantity Float32, l_extendedprice Float64, l_shipdate Date, l_shipmode String) ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_time_travel_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/')
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO itt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_shipmode FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 = {k1} SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000000
ALTER TABLE itt ADD COLUMN l_tax Nullable(Float64)

INSERT INTO itt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_shipmode, l_tax FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 = {k2} SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000000
ALTER TABLE itt RENAME COLUMN l_extendedprice TO price

INSERT INTO itt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_shipmode, l_tax FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 = {k3} SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000000
ALTER TABLE itt MODIFY COLUMN l_partkey Int64
ALTER TABLE itt MODIFY COLUMN l_quantity Float64

INSERT INTO itt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_shipmode, l_tax FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 = {k4} SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000000
ALTER TABLE itt DROP COLUMN l_shipmode

INSERT INTO itt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_tax FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 = {k5} SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000000
CREATE TABLE itt_v15 ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = (SELECT extract(_path, 'iceberg_time_travel_[0-9]+/') FROM itt LIMIT 1)) SETTINGS iceberg_metadata_file_path = 'metadata/v15.metadata.json'
SELECT throwIf(count() != 20) FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt'
SELECT throwIf(count() != 20 OR uniqExact(schema_id) != 5) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt' AND content = 0

SELECT throwIf(groupArray(name) != ['l_orderkey', 'l_partkey', 'l_quantity', 'price', 'l_shipdate', 'l_tax'] OR groupArray(type)[2] != 'Int64') FROM (SELECT name, type FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt' ORDER BY position)

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(round(price * 100)), sum(l_partkey), countIf(l_tax IS NULL) FROM itt) != (count(), sum(round(toFloat64(l_extendedprice) * 100)), sum(l_partkey), countIf(l_orderkey % 20 < 4))) FROM tpch10.lineitem

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(round(price * 100)), countIf(l_tax IS NULL) FROM itt_v15) != (count(), sum(round(toFloat64(l_extendedprice) * 100)), countIf(l_orderkey % 20 < 4))) FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 20 < 12

SELECT throwIf((countIf(l_orderkey % 20 < 8), sumIf(round(toFloat64(l_extendedprice) * 100), l_orderkey % 20 < 8), countIf(l_orderkey % 20 < 12), sumIf(round(toFloat64(l_extendedprice) * 100), l_orderkey % 20 < 12)) != (23990707, 91719191203884, 35988935, 137622675838449)) FROM tpch10.lineitem

SELECT throwIf(groupArray(toUInt64(summary['total-records']))[8] != 23990707 OR groupArray(toUInt64(summary['total-records']))[12] != 35988935) FROM (SELECT summary FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt' ORDER BY made_current_at)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(price), sum(l_partkey), countIf(l_tax IS NULL) FROM itt
SELECT count(), sum(price), countIf(l_tax IS NULL) FROM itt_v15

id=$(${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary "SELECT snapshot_id FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt' ORDER BY made_current_at LIMIT 1 OFFSET 7") ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary "SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(round(l_extendedprice * 100))) != (23990707, 91719191203884)) FROM itt SETTINGS iceberg_snapshot_id = ${id}" -o /dev/null

ts=$(${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary "SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(made_current_at) FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'itt' ORDER BY made_current_at LIMIT 1 OFFSET 11") ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary "SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(round(price * 100))) != (35988935, 137622675838449)) FROM itt SETTINGS iceberg_timestamp_ms = ${ts}" -o /dev/null
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS itt_v15, itt SYNC
